title: Quietly Umami Korean Cheonggukjang Mille Feuille
description: A keto-friendly, umami-rich French dish featuring cheonggukjang, perfect for a lazy Sunday, with a crumbly texture and poached flavors. This mille-feuille is a unique twist on traditional French pastry.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Roll out the puff pastry on a floured surface to a thickness of about 1/8 inch.
Spread the cheonggukjang evenly over the center of the pastry, leaving a 1-inch border on either side.
Brush the edges of the pastry with the melted butter.
Fold the pastry over the filling, pressing gently to seal.
Place the mille-feuille on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Bake the pastry for 25 minutes, or until golden brown.
While the pastry is baking, poach the eggs in simmering water.
To assemble the dish, place a piece of the baked pastry on a plate, top with a poached egg, and sprinkle with parmesan cheese and parsley.
